hors_ligne: No Internet connection. Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.
reseau: Can't reach DevConnect. Check your Internet connection. If it works, the service is briefly unavailable: try again in a moment.
delai: The server is taking too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.
serveur: DevConnect is having a problem on our side. Try again in a moment.
limite: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
corrige: Fix the fields marked in red.

champ.pseudo_min: The username must be at least 3 characters.
champ.email: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
champ.identifiant: Enter your email or your phone number (with +).
champ.mdp_min: The password must be at least 8 characters.
champ.mdp_lettre: The password must contain at least one letter.
champ.mdp_chiffre: The password must contain at least one digit.

github_aucun_compte: No DevConnect account is linked to this GitHub account. Create your account first: on the sign-up page, click “Sign up with GitHub”.
github_indisponible: GitHub sign-in is not available right now. Use your username and password.
